objects.text: Dana Winslow
Dental Hygienist
dana.winslow@email.com · (555) 741-6283 · 123 Maplewood Dr, Riverton, CA
SUMMARY

Licensed Dental Hygienist with over 5 years of clinical experience in preventive dental care and patient education. Proven success improving patient oral health through thorough assessments, personalized treatment plans, and efficient hygiene procedures. Demonstrated ability to increase patient satisfaction scores by 15% and reduce appointment times by 10%, optimizing workflow while maintaining high-quality care standards. Adept at collaborating with dental teams and staying current with best practices and technologies in dental hygiene.
EXPERIENCE
Dental Hygienist — Riverton Family Dental Clinic
June 2019 – Present
• Performed prophylactic cleanings and periodontal assessments for 25+ patients daily, reducing gum disease progression rates by 18% through early intervention.
• Developed personalized oral hygiene plans, resulting in a 20% increase in patient adherence to recommended daily care techniques.
• Collaborated with dentists to implement a new digital charting system, decreasing patient intake paperwork time by 15%.
• Conducted patient education seminars on oral health best practices, increasing community engagement and appointment bookings by 12%.
Dental Hygienist — Greenfield Dental Care
March 2017 – May 2019
• Provided routine dental hygiene services including scaling, polishing, and fluoride treatments to an average of 20 patients per day.
• Assisted in clinical research study evaluating the efficacy of new ultrasonic scaling technology, contributing to published study data approved for clinical trials.
• Maintained accurate patient records, enhancing documentation compliance rates to 98% during quarterly audits.
• Trained and mentored 3 junior hygienists, improving team efficiency and patient care consistency.
EDUCATION
Associate of Applied Science in Dental Hygiene, Crestview Community College, 2016
SKILLS

Clinical Dental Hygiene  ·  Periodontal Assessment  ·  Patient Education & Communication  ·  Digital Charting & Practice Management Software  ·  Infection Control & Sterilization  ·  Ultrasonic & Hand Scaling  ·  Oral Health Promotion
CERTIFICATIONS
• Registered Dental Hygienist (RDH), California Board of Dental Examiners
• CPR and First Aid Certified, American Heart Association
LANGUAGES
